text.en: MT-NLG is row 41 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: MT-NLG 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 41 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates MT-NLG with “Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model”.
text.zh: 年度表把 MT-NLG 与论文《Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Shaden Smith, Mostofa Patwary, Bryan Catanzaro”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Shaden Smith（官方页拼写）、Mostofa Patwary（官方页拼写）、Bryan Catanzaro（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Shaden Smith, Mostofa Patwary, Bryan Catanzaro”。
